paragraphs.en: I've travelled a lot in my life, but I've never been as lost as I was in Germany two years ago. I was studying in Berlin on an exchange programme, and one weekend I decided to visit a friend in Hamburg.
paragraphs.uz: Hayotimda ko'p sayohat qilganman, lekin ikki yil oldin Germaniyadagidek hech qachon adashmaganman. Berlinda almashinuv dasturi bo'yicha o'qiyotgan edim va bir dam olish kuni Gamburgdagi do'stimni ko'rishga qaror qildim.

paragraphs.en: The station was huge and very busy. My train was leaving in three minutes, so I ran to the platform, jumped onto the first train I saw and sat down, feeling proud of myself.
paragraphs.uz: Vokzal ulkan va juda gavjum edi. Poyezdim uch daqiqadan keyin jo'nardi, shuning uchun platformaga yugurdim, ko'rgan birinchi poyezdga sakrab chiqdim va o'zimdan mamnun holda o'tirdim.

paragraphs.en: About an hour later, the conductor checked my ticket and frowned. "This ticket is for Hamburg," he said politely. "But this train is going to Leipzig." I couldn't believe it. I was going in completely the opposite direction!
paragraphs.uz: Taxminan bir soatdan keyin konduktor chiptamni tekshirib, qovog'ini soldi. "Bu chipta Gamburgga," dedi u xushmuomalalik bilan. "Lekin bu poyezd Leyptsigga ketyapti." Ishonolmadim. Men butunlay teskari tomonga ketayotgan ekanman!

paragraphs.en: I got off at the next town, which was tiny and quiet. While I was waiting for a train back, an old man started talking to me. He had worked in Tashkent in the 1980s and still remembered a few words of Uzbek! We had coffee together and he told me amazing stories.
paragraphs.uz: Keyingi shaharchada tushdim — u juda kichkina va sokin edi. Qaytish poyezdini kutayotganimda bir keksa kishi men bilan gaplasha boshladi. U 1980-yillarda Toshkentda ishlagan ekan va hali ham bir nechta o'zbekcha so'zni eslardi! Birga qahva ichdik va u menga ajoyib voqealarni so'zlab berdi.

paragraphs.en: I arrived in Hamburg five hours late. My friend laughed at me, but honestly, I wasn't upset. Sometimes the wrong train takes you to the right place.
paragraphs.uz: Gamburgga besh soat kechikib yetib keldim. Do'stim ustimdan kuldi, lekin rostini aytsam, xafa emas edim. Ba'zan noto'g'ri poyezd seni to'g'ri joyga olib boradi.

options: Not upset — it was a good experience
